agile.board_invalid: Check the columns: each holds statuses of the workflow, each status in one column

agile.remove_sprint_confirm: Remove {name}? Its issues go back to the backlog.

agile.points_invalid: The story points are from 0 to 999
search.title: Search
search.help: Write a query and press Enter. For example: `type = bug AND assignee = currentUser()`, `status IN (todo, in_progress) ORDER BY priority DESC`, `text ~ "coupon" AND created >= -14d`. The field suggests fields, operators and values as you type.
search.shared_help: Everyone in the organisation sees the filter; each one finds only the issues they may see
search.wrong_query: The query is not right: check it in the field above
dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.overdue_help: Your open issues past their due date
dashboard.reviewing_help: Issues in progress you are the reviewer of
dashboard.critical_help: Open bugs with the highest priority in your projects
dashboard.resolved_help: Issues of your projects resolved since Monday
dashboard.my_filters_help: Your saved filters marked «On my dashboard» in Search, with the issues each one finds now.
reports.title: Project dashboard
reports.cycle_time_caption: median days from start to done

reports.burndown_sprint_help: Empty: the active sprint, or the last one
reports.velocity_caption: Story points of the last six completed sprints
reports.flow_caption: Issues per status category, last 30 days
reports.created_resolved_caption: Issues created and resolved per day, last 30 days
notification_settings.description: How OpenDevTrack tells you about your work: in the application, by email at once, or in a daily summary.
